fragments.text: Hello, Wayside Camera Club, Breda speaking.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 你好，Wayside摄影俱乐部，我是布雷达。

fragments.text: Oh, hello, um, my name's Dan and I'd like to join your club.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 噢，你好，嗯，我叫丹，我想加入你们的俱乐部。

fragments.text: That's great, Dan. We have an
would you like to complete it over the phone, then you can ask any questions you might have?

sentences.translation: 太好了，丹。我们有申请表，你愿意在电话中填写吗？然后你可以问任何你可能有的问题。

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 哦，好的，谢谢。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 好的，那么你的姓氏是什么？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 格林，丹·格林。

sentences.translation: 那么，可以告诉我你的电子邮件地址吗？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 好的，是dan1068@market.com。

sentences.translation: 谢谢。你的家庭地址呢？

acceptedAnswers: ten miles away from your club

fragments.text: in Peacetown. I live in a house there.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯，我离你们俱乐部大约十英里，住在和平镇的一栋房子里。

fragments.text: OK, so what's the house number and street?

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 好的，那么门牌号和街道是什么？

sentences.speaker: Dan

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 是M-A双R-O-W-F-I-E-L-D吗？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 没错。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: ……你说那是和平镇？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯。

fragments.text: ? Did you look on the internet?

sentences.translation: 那么你是怎么听说我们俱乐部的？是在网上看到的吗？

fragments.text: I usually do that, but this time, well, I was
the other day and he suggested it.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 我通常会那样做，但这次，嗯，前几天我和一个亲戚聊天，他建议我来这里。

fragments.text: Oh, is he a member too?

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 哦，他也是会员吗？

fragments.text: - but he'd heard good things about yours.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 他属于另一个俱乐部，但他听说过你们俱乐部的好评。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 好的。那你希望加入后得到什么？

fragments.text: that you have. I enjoy entering those.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯，有一件让我很感兴趣的事是你们举办的比赛。我喜欢参加比赛。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 好的。还有别的吗？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯，我还喜欢和其他摄影师交流。

fragments.text: That's great. So what would you like?

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 太好了。那你想要哪种会员资格？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 有哪些选择？

acceptedAnswers: £20 a year if you're an associate

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 正式会员每年30英镑，准会员每年20英镑。

fragments.text: I think I'll go for the

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 那我想选择正式会员。

in meetings with an associate membership.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 这是个好主意，因为准会员不能在会议上投票。

fragments.text: If I could just find out a bit more about you ...

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 如果我能再了解一下你……

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 好的。

fragments.text: So you said you wanted to compete - have you ever won any

sentences.translation: 你说你想参加比赛——你以前赢过任何摄影比赛吗？

fragments.text: Not yet, but I have entered three in the past.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 还没有，但我以前参加过三次。

fragments.text: Oh, that's interesting. So why don't you tell me something about those? Let's start with the first one.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 哦，那很有趣。那你给我讲讲这些比赛吧？我们从第一次开始。

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯，主题是‘家庭生活’。

fragments.text: I see - so it had to be something related to the home?

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 我明白了——所以必须是和家有关的东西？

fragments.text: Yeah. I chose to take a photo of

acceptedAnswers: a family sitting round the dinner table having a meal

fragments.text: and, um, I didn't win, but I did get some

sentences.translation: 是的。我选择拍了一张家人围坐在餐桌旁吃饭的照片，嗯，我没赢，但确实得到了一些反馈。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 哦，评委怎么说？

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 他们说作为一张照片来说太‘杂乱’了。

acceptedAnswers: composition of the picture that they criticised

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 啊哈——所以他们批评的是照片的构图。

fragments.text: That's right - and once they'd told me that, I could see my mistake.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 没错——他们一告诉我，我就看出自己的问题了。

fragments.text: So what was the theme of the

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 那第二次比赛的主题是什么？

fragments.text: Well, my university was on the coast and that area gets a lot of beautiful

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 嗯，我的大学在海边，那里有很多美丽的日落，所以主题就是日落。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 哦，日落，这是个好主题。

fragments.text: as well - it couldn't just be blue sky and a setting sun.

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 是的。要求是也要拍到云——不能只是蓝天和落日。

fragments.text: Sure, cause they give you all those amazing pinks and purples.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 当然，因为云会带来那些令人惊叹的粉紫色。

acceptedAnswers: bit longer to get the shot

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 是的——我以为我拍得不错，但反馈说我应该多等一会儿再拍。

fragments.text: I see. So the timing wasn't right.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 我明白了。所以时机不对。

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 是的——基本上我拍得太早了。然后我参加的第三次比赛叫做‘动物魔力’。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 嗯，这是个困难的题材。

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 我知道！我不得不拍了几百张照片。

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 我确信——因为动物总是在动。

. I got a great shot of a fox in

fragments.text: Well Dan - you seem to be really keen and we'd be

acceptedAnswers: delighted to have you in our club

fragments.text: I'm sure we can help with all those areas that you've outlined.

sentences.speaker: Breda
sentences.translation: 丹——你看起来真的很热心，我们很高兴你能加入我们的俱乐部。我相信我们能在你提到的所有方面帮到你。

sentences.speaker: Dan
sentences.translation: 谢谢，那太好了。
